request.request: Write the paragraph from the officer's details in document 1.

response_text: {"paragraph":"Math Club is putting on the Pi Day Puzzle Hunt, an event where teams of students solve puzzles across campus. It is open to students who enjoy a good challenge, whether they love math or are just curious and want to spend time with others working through clues together. We are reaching out to your organization because we would love to have a fellow recognized student organization co-host the event with us, including helping write half of the puzzles. A partner with a different perspective would make the hunt more varied and more fun for the students who take part, and it would help make sure the puzzles feel fresh and welcoming to people with all kinds of interests.","contains_instructions":false}
